modifications: Entries were selected, normalised (HTML removed, years parsed, headline titles shortened to about 100 characters with an ellipsis), merged and de-duplicated across sources, ranked, capped per day and category, and sorted. Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). Image links are unmodified Wikimedia URLs.

did_you_know.fact: On May 26, 1923: The first 24 Hours of Le Mans is held in France. Run annually in June thereafter, it became the oldest endurance racing event in the world.
On May 26, 1998: The first "National Sorry Day" is held in Australia. Reconciliation events are held nationally, and attended by over a million people.
On May 26, 1991: Zviad Gamsakhurdia becomes the first elected President of the Republic of Georgia in the post-Soviet era.

image_credit.author: George barateli by George Barateli in 1989

did_you_know.fact: On May 26, 1969: Apollo program: Apollo 10 returns to Earth after a successful eight-day test of all the components needed for the forthcoming first crewed Moon landing.
May 26 is observed as Mother's Day (Poland).
